name.title: Site key
name.description: Stable site identifier used in beacon URLs and history. Renaming creates a new history identity.

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Human-readable site name. Leave empty to use the site key.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins
allowed_origins.description: Web origins allowed to send telemetry, such as https://example.org. A leading *. allows subdomains only.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Public receiver base URL used for this site's installation snippet. Leave empty to use the receiver public URL.

window.title: Measurement window
window.description: Receiver-arrival window for recent browser measurements and distinct observed sessions. Accepts durations between 1m and 30m.

page_groups.title: Page groups
page_groups.description: Maximum individual page groups shown in breakdown charts. Remaining groups are combined as other.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Maximum individual countries shown in breakdown charts. Remaining countries are combined as other.

measure_sample_rate.title: Browser collection rate
measure_sample_rate.description: Share of browser sessions collected, from 0 to 1. Omitted or null means all; zero disables collection. Browser measurement charts are absent while collection is disabled; receiver diagnostics remain available.

investigate.title: Detail sampling
investigate.description: Select native investigation history and enabled event-log and trace exports from received sessions. Leave empty to select all received sessions.

sample_rate.title: Baseline detail sample rate
sample_rate.description: Baseline share of received sessions selected for detail, from 0 to 1. Omitted or null means all; zero selects only the problem overrides below.

always_keep.title: Problem overrides
always_keep.description: Conditions that select detail beyond the baseline sample. Omitted or null keeps errors and poor vitals; an empty list disables overrides.

bots.title: Bot handling
bots.description: Exclude crawlers and browser automation by default, or include them as bot traffic.

tracing.title: Browser tracing
tracing.description: Capture browser request spans and propagate trace context. Backend spans require separately instrumented services.

enabled.title: Enable browser tracing
enabled.description: Capture and export browser spans independently of event logs. Disabled by default.

propagate_to.title: Trace propagation origins
propagate_to.description: Additional literal API origins receiving trace headers. Same-origin requests receive them automatically; cross-origin APIs must allow the trace headers in CORS.

not.$comment: IPv4 octets inside IPv6 must not have leading zeros; URI format validators differ on this.

redact_paths.title: Path redaction
redact_paths.description: Apply site-specific URL-path replacements before built-in normalization. These rules do not anonymize user IDs or provide general data-loss prevention.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Go regular expression matching private path identifiers. Empty patterns are ignored.

replace.title: Replacement
replace.description: Replacement text for matching path segments. Leave empty to remove them.

event_logs.title: Event logs
event_logs.description: Export sampled browser events for search, including custom-event attributes. Native RUM history works independently.

enabled.title: Enable event logs
enabled.description: Send event logs to the configured destination. Disabled by default; native charts, sessions and errors remain available.

include_console_logs.title: Include console logs
include_console_logs.description: Capture console info, warn and error messages for investigated sessions. Effective only when event logs are enabled.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Choose optional location and interaction evidence independently of sampling. Defaults retain country comparisons and disable frustration heuristics.

geolocation.title: Geolocation
geolocation.description: IP-derived location detail: off disables lookup, country retains country comparisons, and city adds approximate live map markers. Omitted or null means country; coordinates are never retained in history or exported.

frustration_signals.title: Frustration signals
frustration_signals.description: Enable rage, dead and error click heuristics and their browser instrumentation. Disabled by default; these signals do not establish user intent or causality.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Receiver for this signal only. Leave unset to use the local OTLP/gRPC receiver.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: OTLP/gRPC receiver URL with an explicit port. Use http for plaintext or https for TLS; paths, credentials, query strings and fragments are not allowed.

auth_token.title: Authentication token
auth_token.description: Bearer token accepted by the receiver. Use a native secret reference; leave empty for no authentication.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA certificate
tls_ca.description: CA certificate file for verifying an HTTPS receiver. Leave empty to use system roots.

tls_cert.title: TLS client certificate
tls_cert.description: Client certificate file for an HTTPS receiver. Set together with TLS key; leave both empty to omit client authentication.

tls_key.title: TLS client key
tls_key.description: Client private key file for an HTTPS receiver. Set together with TLS client certificate.

not.$comment: IPv4 octets inside IPv6 must not have leading zeros; URI format validators differ on this.

event_logs.ui:help: Saved destination settings are retained while disabled. Secret references must still resolve for the whole job to start.

include_console_logs.ui:help: Console errors remain optional logs, with bounded and redacted error detail when available. Uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections remain core RUM errors.

tracing.ui:help: Saved destination settings are retained while disabled. Secret references must still resolve for the whole job to start.

propagate_to.ui:help: To join browser and backend spans, instrument the backend, accept propagated context, coordinate sampling, and send both sides to the same tracing system. Sending browser spans alone does not produce a complete backend trace.

measure_sample_rate.ui:help: Lower positive rates reduce browser traffic. Existing browser sessions may keep their earlier sampling decision; zero also discards their traffic at the receiver. Excluded sessions cannot be recovered by detail sampling.

investigate.ui:help: For problems-only detail, set the baseline rate to 0 and keep the default overrides. For measurements and live views without retained or exported detail, also set always_keep to an empty list. Problem overrides preserve available recent native context plus current and future detail while the session remains tracked. Earlier event logs and spans are not exported retrospectively; complete sessions and traces are not guaranteed.
